senses.gloss: (v. שְׁלָמָא) in peace, well, whence (as a dialectic term) granted, it is right, it would be right.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 7a:3">Pes. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ שבת … אלא וכ׳</he> it is right as far as ‘a Sabbath’ is concerned, for it may happen on an eve of Passover concurring with a Sabbath, but (when it says) ‘on a Holy Day’, how can &c.? Ib. 24ᵇ <he>ב׳ אי</he> … <he>שפיר וכ׳</he> I grant, if …, it would be right (to infer that &c.), but now &c. Ib. 50ᵃ <he>ב׳ למאן דאמר … היינו</he> it is right according to him who says …, but according to &c.; a. v. fr. <he>אי אמרת ב׳</he> = <he>ב׳ אי אמרת</he>, v. <cite ref="A01111"><he>אִי</he> II</cite>.
